stem.text: A transverse wave on a rope has wavelength $\lambda$ and period $T$.
The graph shows the variation of the displacement of the particles of the rope with distance in the direction of travel of the wave at time $t = 0$.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement against distance for a transverse wave at t = 0, with the wavelength λ marked on the distance axis, particle X labelled on the curve, and an arrow labelled direction of travel.

stem.text: Which graph shows the variation of the displacement of particle X with time $t$?

A.alt: Graph of displacement against t, with T marked on the time axis; the curve starts at zero, rises to a peak, falls through zero to a trough and returns to zero at T.

B.alt: Graph of displacement against t, with T marked on the time axis; the curve starts at a positive value, falls through zero to a trough and rises to a positive value at T.

C.alt: Graph of displacement against t, with T marked on the time axis; the curve starts at zero, falls to a trough, rises through zero to a peak and returns to zero at T.

D.alt: Graph of displacement against t, with T marked on the time axis; the curve starts at a negative value, rises through zero to a peak, falls through zero to a trough and ends at a negative value.
